inspection: All five exported PNGs visually inspected. Development-axis headroom was increased to avoid cutting marker tops, and constraint curves were given redundant shape/color encoding; both corrected figures were re-inspected. Labels and legends are readable, paired gathers use common amplitudes at actual selected coordinates, and comparisons include every registered condition and method. No trace normalization or amplitude clipping is used.
limits: Several method curves overlap because differences are small; full numeric data are in CSV. PNG layout review also describes PDFs exported from the same figure objects; PDF font embedding, formal accessibility certification and journal-specific compliance were not separately audited.
provenance: Image hashes and source CSV hashes are in manifest.json. Review confirms layout and encoding, not scientific novelty or physical recovery.
